ans = "Yes"

h, w, n = map(int, input().split())
a = list(map(int, input().split()))
a.sort(reverse=True)
l = [[h, w]]

for i in range(n):
    x = 2 ** a[i]
    y = 2 ** a[i]

    m = len(l)
    f = 0
    for j in range(m):
        s = l[j][0]
        t = l[j][1]

        if x <= s and y <= t:
            l.pop(j)
            w1 = x
            h1 = t - y

            if 0 < h1:
                p = [w1, h1]
                p.sort()
                l.append(p)

            w2 = s - x
            h2 = t

            if 0 < w2:
                q = [w2, h2]
                q.sort()
                l.append(q)

            f = 1
            break

    if f == 0:
        ans = "No"
        break

print(ans)
